name: Icon

examples.title: Font Awesome Large
examples.code:
<Icon
  name="star"
  variant="solid"
  features="fa-2x"
  ariaLabel="Star icon large"
/>

examples.title: Bordered
examples.code:
<Icon
  name="star"
  size="large"
  variant="solid"
  features={['fa-border', 'fa-2x']}
  ariaLabel="Star bordered"
/>

examples.title: With Text Color
examples.code:
<Icon
  name="star"
  textColor="primary"
  ariaLabel="Star icon with primary text color"
/>

examples.title: With Margin
examples.code: <Icon name="star" m="2" ariaLabel="Star icon with margin" />

examples.title: With Container Size
examples.code: <Icon name="star" size="large" ariaLabel="Star icon large container" />

examples.title: Google Material Icons
examples.code:
<Block display="flex" gap="4" alignItems="center">
  <Icon library="material-icons" name="favorite" ariaLabel="Filled heart" />
  <Icon
    library="material-icons"
    name="favorite"
    variant="outlined"
    ariaLabel="Outlined heart"
  />
  <Icon
    library="material-icons"
    name="favorite"
    variant="round"
    ariaLabel="Round heart"
  />
</Block>

examples.title: Material Symbols
examples.code:
<Block display="flex" gap="4" alignItems="center">
  <Icon
    library="material-symbols"
    name="settings"
    ariaLabel="Settings outlined"
  />
  <Icon
    library="material-symbols"
    name="settings"
    variant="rounded"
    ariaLabel="Settings rounded"
  />
  <Icon
    library="material-symbols"
    name="settings"
    variant="sharp"
    ariaLabel="Settings sharp"
  />
</Block>

examples.title: Material Design Icons
examples.code: <Icon library="mdi" name="home" ariaLabel="Material Design home icon" />

examples.title: Custom node
examples.code:
<Icon ariaLabel="Custom SVG icon" textColor="primary">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="1em" height="1em" fill="currentColor">
    <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" />
  </svg>
</Icon>

accessibility:
- **ARIA label:** `ariaLabel` defaults to `'icon'` and is applied to the container span **unconditionally** — an `Icon` that never sets it still renders `aria-label="icon"`. For an icon-only control, put the real `aria-label` on the control (e.g. `Button`) and set `aria-hidden` on the `Icon`; for a decorative icon beside visible text, set `aria-hidden` on the `Icon` so it doesn't add `"icon"` to the accessible name.
- **Keyboard:** If interactive, use with `Button` or `a` and put the ARIA (`aria-label`, roles) on that control.
- **Color and size:** Use `textColor`, `bgColor`, and `size` for accessible, themeable icons.

:::note
For purely decorative icons, you can use `aria-hidden="true"` via the `...rest` props.
:::
summary: The `Icon` component is a Bulma-styled wrapper for displaying icons from various libraries (Font Awesome, Material Design Icons, Ionicons, Google Material Icons, Material Symbols, etc.).

parts.summary: The `Icon` component is a Bulma-styled wrapper for displaying icons from various libraries (Font Awesome, Material Design Icons, Ionicons, Google Material Icons, Material Symbols, etc.).

props.name: name
props.description: The icon name, with or without its library prefix (e.g. `'star'` or `'fa-star'`). Mutually exclusive with `children`.

props.name: children
props.description: A custom node (an inline SVG, a `react-icons` component, …) rendered inside the `.icon` container in place of a class-based glyph. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier for the icon.

props.name: library
props.description: The icon library to use ('fa' = Font Awesome, 'mdi' = Material Design Icons, 'ion' = Ionicons Web Components, 'material-icons' = Google Material Icons, 'material-symbols' = Google Material Symbols). Defaults to the value set in ConfigProvider or 'fa' if not configured. Ignored when `children` supplies the glyph instead of `name`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Icon style variant (e.g. `'solid'`, `'outlined'`, `'rounded'`). Ignored when `children` supplies the glyph instead of `name`.

props.name: features
props.description: Additional modifiers (e.g. `'fa-lg'`, `'fa-spin'`, `'is-size-1'`). Ignored when `children` supplies the glyph instead of `name`.

props.name: size
props.description: Size modifier for the icon container.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: ARIA label for accessibility. Applied unconditionally to the container span, so an icon that never sets it still renders `aria-label="icon"`. For an icon-only control, put the real `aria-label` on the control (e.g. `Button`) and set `aria-hidden` here instead — otherwise the control's accessible name is announced as just "icon". For a decorative icon beside visible text, set `aria-hidden` here rather than leaving the default, so it doesn't add "icon" to the text's accessible name.
